members.name: Dmitri Sokolov
members.backstory: Dmitri was an appliance repair tech — washers, dryers, the sad symphony of dying compressors. He has fixed machines other techs wrote off as corpses. Fixes the solar panels. Curses in Russian. It helps.

members.name: Rosa Mendez
members.backstory: Rosa ran the fry station at a roadside diner. She can tell when oil is ready by the sound. She did the same math every shift: what feeds people, fast. Feeds twelve like she fed four hundred. Portions are law.

members.name: Ursula Weber
members.backstory: Ursula ran the family funeral home in Vienna, third generation. She knows the human body the way a mechanic knows an engine. Her grandparents came from Vancouver; she grew up hearing English at home. Handles the dead with dignity. The living are harder.

members.name: Caleb Jones
members.backstory: Caleb ran into burning buildings for the Miami fire department for eleven years. He knows what fear sounds like in his own head and how to walk through it. Keeps the fire. It's a whole job.
